name: Naphtali
bio: Naphtali is the second son born to Jacob through Rachel's servant Bilhah. After years of rivalry with her sister Leah over childbearing, Rachel said when this son was born, "With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed," and named him "Naphtali," meaning "my wrestling" (Genesis 30:8). Naphtali later became one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
